cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dishes done. Before you go, remember how I taught you to finish an argument? Sit down; we're not okay yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stayed to clean up. That's finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beautifully cleaned. You always did the practical part well. Now stay for the bit where you look at me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got ten minutes before the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me nine. No rehearsed apology; you used to rush that exercise. Tell me one thing you still like about being here with me.
